{{Top|leg}}
The '''Stop Dead''' was an emergency maneuver for stopping a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traveling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] when the vessel's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] had been destroyed. The maneuver was highly dangerous, as it had an eighty-three percent chance of resulting in the ship becoming a fine powder floating through [[Realspace/Legends|space]].
